Asha (Sec): Heads up: starting 2026-03-31 we will enforce least-privilege IAM. Project-level wildcard roles (Editor/Owner) will be denied for service accounts and CI pipelines. Action required: owners must replace broad bindings with scoped roles or custom roles.
Diego (Cloud): Is this org-wide? Any exceptions?
Asha (Sec): Org-wide. Short non-prod exceptions possible with approval. Prod and infra projects: no exceptions.
Lena (Platform): Migration playbook?
Asha (Sec): Runbook posted: https://redwood.internal/docs/security/iam-least-priv (summary below). Key steps: 1) inventory bindings, 2) map permissions to minimal roles, 3) create custom role if needed, 4) apply change and test, 5) document in SEC-4410.
Diego (Cloud): Quick inventory commands for GCP:
```
# list bindings
gcloud projects get-iam-policy my-project --format="json" > policy.json
# find Editor/Owner bindings
jq '.bindings[] | select(.role=="roles/editor" or .role=="roles/owner")' policy.json
```
Priya (DevEx): I'll add a small script to our infra/tools that maps common service usages to recommended roles and outputs a diff.
Asha (Sec): Please do and link in the runbook. Tag SEC-4410 when ready.
sec-bot: Automated scan scheduled: daily IAM-binding audit. Initial scan in progress; results will post here.
Lena (Platform): How will we enforce denial? Policy engine or manual audits?
Asha (Sec): We'll deploy an org policy guard and automatic PR checks for infra repos. After the deadline, any attempts to push project-level broad bindings will be blocked and flagged.
Priya (DevEx): Timeline for helpers?
Priya (DevEx): I'll open PR with mapping script by EOW.
Diego (Cloud): I'll start inventorying top 25 projects and assign owners.
Asha (Sec): Action items recap: 1) run inventory and list owners in SEC-4410. 2) replace Editor/Owner service bindings with scoped roles by 2026-03-31. 3) request exception in SEC-4410 with justification if absolutely needed. Noncompliance will result in automated role removal and security review. Ping me for help. :lock:
